question: Can deployment-available IMU gravity and deterministic predicted-depth/K/support geometry close Attempt-02 support-normal and camera-height failures while preserving the eight already transferred factor metrics?

TRAIN_CANARY.open_rule: Only after all three seed-specific geometry configurations pass every selection primary and uncertainty gate.

frozen_model.architecture: Attempt-02 FactorSplitHead with frozen DepthART-S features and component checkpoints; no parameter is trained or changed.
frozen_model.deployment_input_change: Support normal is a sensor-derived factor from normalized IMU gravity, not an RGB-only learned claim.

support_geometry.normal: Normalize gravity_up_camera_xyz and copy it to support_plane_normal_camera_xyz when valid; otherwise retain the Attempt-02 fail-closed output.
support_geometry.height: Backproject the frozen model's predicted or base DepthART metric depth with bound K; project points onto IMU up; use only predicted support/depth-valid pixels; estimate positive camera height by a frozen weighted quantile or weighted height mode.

selection.height_rule: Require positive camera-height improvement on both selection parents; choose minimum worst-parent absolute-log error, then parent mean, fallback count and config SHA.
selection.support_sigma_rule: Require positive parent-macro support-NLL gain and nondecreasing observed residual over four predicted-sigma groups; choose minimum support NLL then config SHA.
selection.full_eligibility: Every one of the ten primary factor metrics and all three uncertainty families must pass before any canary feature or truth is opened.

held_success.primary_metrics: For each of ten metrics, 10,000 parent bootstrap 95 percent lower improvement bound over the frozen FIT-only baseline is greater than zero and favorable-parent fraction is at least 0.75.
held_success.uncertainty_proper_score: Depth, support and boundary parent-macro NLL gain over the frozen FIT-only homoscedastic baseline must each be greater than zero.
held_success.uncertainty_ordering: Depth and boundary use all valid pixel sigma/residual pairs split into four equal-count predicted-sigma groups. Scalar support sigma uses the six valid frame-level sigma/mean-residual pairs. Every family's observed residual means must be nondecreasing.

claim_boundary: TRAIN-only RGB+K+IMU factor availability and transfer canary. No reducer utility, deployment performance, product or safety claim.
